finding: The DXF MPOLYGON reader inherited DRW_Hatch solid=1 when group 71 was absent, so a pattern record was delivered as solid.

sources.title: Autodesk HATCH/DXF group codes
sources.relevance: For MPOLYGON group 71 is the solid-fill flag; zero means no solid fill.

sources.title: ezdxf MPOLYGON source
sources.relevance: The independent DXF implementation defines group 71 default zero.

change: Initialize only the DXF processMPolygon local record to solid=0 before parsing; explicit group 71 still wins. Direct construction, HATCH and DWG defaults are unchanged.
validation: Generated selector libdxfrw_mpolygon_fill_default failed before the change and passes after it in ASCII and Binary for omitted/explicit solid/explicit pattern/omitted order, with both typed and legacy HATCH callbacks.
Directly constructed DRW_Hatch and DRW_MPolygon defaults remain 1.
The upstream-linked LibreCAD omitted-71 case passes (3 assertions). The combined DIMASSOC/MPOLYGON selector improves from 3/11 to 4/11, leaving 7 failed cases and 17 failed assertions.
limits: The absent-field default is corroborated by ezdxf and LibreCAD bundled behavior; this is not independent native consumer qualification.
Other MPOLYGON path, trailer and writer discrepancies and DIMASSOC cases remain open.
